evidence_limitations: The temporary wall-clock benchmark brief specified seeds such as 70000+, but no surviving exact benchmark seed log, result, model, or runner exists in the formal repository/current temp inventory; exact values were not invented.
Early-exit unit-test seed searches do not persist their final examined seed, so their full declared 0-9999 search domain is conservatively reserved.
No complete validated party-size outcome table was found in the existing evaluation pipeline, so party-size metrics are not preregistered.
